title: 20th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2/2026).

Written question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Ali Shareef: President Muizzu promised B. Kihaadhoo a waste management centre extension on 13 August 2025 and assigned it to Fenaka; some materials arrived but work has stalled, so when will it be completed?

Written question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Ali Shareef: B. Kamadhoo suffers from power load failures, delayed electricity connections to newly settled areas and an unresolved harbour power network fault; when will proper service begin?

Written question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Climate Change, Environment and Energy, Ali Shareef: President Muizzu repeatedly promised a new B. Kihaadhoo powerhouse building on 13 August 2025; why has no practical work started and when will the relocation be completed?
First reading of the bill to amend the Decentralization Act (Law No. 7/2010), submitted by Thulhaadhoo MP Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill on Leasing Uninhabited Islands and Lagoons, submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed calling on the government to immediately halt the sale of permanent residence permits to foreigners under the "Maldives Pearl Residence Programme" and disclose all related agreements to Parliament.
Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominee for the Maldives' Permanent Representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting took three written questions on Baa atoll utilities, introduced a Decentralization Act amendment, continued the island-leasing and Pearl Residence debates, and considered an IRENA envoy report.
